blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: ufakzeka-kulak is an open Turkish speech-to-text model of 31.6M parameters, a FastConformer encoder with a token-and-duration transducer (TDT) and a CTC head, trained from scratch and released under Apache-2.0. It writes cased, punctuated Turkish with numbers as words. Its 4,977 training hours come from sources whose licences allow commercial use; 281 hours are human-transcribed, and for the other 4,696 the training text is an uploader subtitle or a machine transcript, kept only where a second, independent reading of the audio agrees with it. The recipe, checkpoint, labelling and export choices were made on development data, and the test sets were scored once, in a release gate fixed before training. With greedy TDT decoding the normalised word error rate (WER) is 0.0921 (95 percent interval 0.0792 to 0.1055) on FLEURS Turkish test and 0.0916 (0.0873 to 0.0958) on Common Voice 27.0 Turkish test, lower than Whisper base and Whisper small on both sets with paired intervals wholly below zero; Whisper large-v3 (greedy) scores 0.0604 and 0.0767. On conversational speech the WER is 0.3807. We also report punctuation and casing, degraded audio, and how closely each shipped export reproduces the trained model.
blocks.zh: ufakzeka-kulak是一个开放的土耳其语音对文本模型,参数为31.6M,一个快conformer编码器,并配有活字和活字转录器(TDT)和CTC头,从零开始训练,并在Apache-2.0下放出. 它写成案例,用数字来表示土耳其语。 其4,977个培训小时来自许可证允许商业使用的来源;281个小时是人文的;其他4,696个培训小时是上传字幕或机器笔录,只有在对音频进行第二次独立阅读时才予以保存。 在开发数据方面作出了食谱、检查站、标签和出口选择,在培训前固定的放行门内,测试套次打分。 由于贪婪的TDT解码,在FLEURS土耳其测试中,常态字错误率(WER)为0.0921分(95%间隔为0.0792至0.1055分),在共同之声27.0土耳其测试中为0.0916分(0.0873至0.0958分),低于Whisper Base和Whisper在两套配对间隔完全低于0分;Whisper大V3(greedy)分数为0.0604分和0.076分. 在谈话演说中,WER是0.3807. 我们还报告弹出和外壳、已退化的音频,以及每批发货如何密切复制训练有素的模型。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Speech recognition for Turkish is available from large multilingual models such as Whisper [ 3 ] , OWSM [ 5 ] and Omnilingual ASR [ 6 ] . ufakzeka-kulak ( kulak is Turkish for ear) is a small model for one language, meant to run offline on a laptop, a server or in a browser page, with a licence that allows commercial use and a published list of every training source. It follows the lab’s language model ufakzeka-1 [ 1 ] and decision model ufakzeka-karar [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 对土耳其语的语音识别可以从Whisper [3],OWSM [5]和Omnilanguage ASR [6]. ufakzeka-kulak(kulak为土耳其语为耳语)是一个语言的小型模型,意在在笔记本电脑,服务器或浏览器页面上运行下线,拥有允许商业使用的许可,并发布每个培训来源的清单. 它遵循实验室的语言模型ufakzeka-1 [1]和决定模型ufakzeka-kar [2].

blocks.en: The model is a FastConformer [ 8 ] with a TDT decoder [ 9 ] and a CTC head [ 10 ] on the same encoder, trained from scratch with NVIDIA NeMo [ 38 ] . We make four contributions: (i) the model, with exports for transformers [ 39 ] , sherpa-onnx [ 40 ] , parakeet.cpp [ 42 ] and parakeet-mlx [ 43 ] , each measured against NeMo; (ii) a labelling pipeline for speech without trusted transcripts, in which one open recogniser writes the text and an independent one checks it, with both models and the agreement threshold chosen on human-transcribed speech that is not trained on; (iii) a recipe chosen by design pilots read by rules fixed before the runs, and a release gate fixed before any training; and (iv) reports beyond the gate on punctuation and casing, degraded audio, a media test set and the runtime differences we found. Every number for the released model traces to a result file committed in the project’s repository. Square brackets give 95 percent intervals from a blockwise percentile bootstrap [ 20 ] with 2,000 resamples (seed 0), in blocks of speakers for Common Voice and Real-TurnTurk, of sentences for FLEURS, which publishes no speaker ids, and of clips for ISSAI TSC dev and MediaSpeech, which have none; a difference between two systems is paired, with the same draws for both.
blocks.zh: 该型号为快相机 [8] 有TDT解码器 [9] 和CTC头 [10] 在同一编码器上,由NVIDIA NeMo从头开始训练. [38]. 我们作出了四项贡献:(一) 模型,出口变压器[39]、Sherpa-onnx[40]、parakeet.cpp[42]和parakeet-mlx[43],每个变压器都比照NeMo进行测量;(二) 标有没有可信记录的语音标记管道,其中有一个公开识别器写出文字,一个独立检查,其中标有两种模型和协议阈值,在未经训练的人文演讲上都选取;(三) 设计飞行员在运行前按既定规则选择的配方,以及在任何培训前固定的放出闸口;(四) 门外的报告,有凹凸和弹壳、退化的音频、媒体测试和我们发现的运行时间差异。 发布模型的每个数字都追踪到项目存储库中执行的结果文件。 平方括号给出了95%的间隔,从一个平方百分位的靴子[20]取出2,000个重印(种子0),以共同之声和Real-TurnTurk的扬声器块取出,以FLEURS的句子取出没有扬声器ID的句子取出,以ISSAI TSC Dev和MediaSpeech的片段取出,它们没有;两个系统之间的区别被对接,两者的画幅相同.

blocks.en: 2 Model
blocks.zh: 2 型号

blocks.en: The encoder has 16 FastConformer layers of width 256 with 4 attention heads, a feed-forward expansion of 4, a convolution kernel of 9 and depthwise-separable striding that reduces time by a factor of 8. The encoder feeds two outputs, a TDT decoder and a CTC head. The TDT decoder has a one-layer prediction network and a joint network, both of width 640, and predicts each token with a duration of 0 to 4 frames; the TDT loss uses σ = 0.02 \sigma=0.02 and ω = 0.1 \omega=0.1 [ 9 ] . The CTC head is trained with weight 0.3, and an intermediate CTC loss [ 11 ] of weight 0.3 is applied after the eighth encoder layer. Input is 16,000 Hz mono audio as 80 log-mel features with a 25 ms window and a 10 ms stride, with SpecAugment [ 15 ] (two frequency masks of width up to 27 and ten time masks of up to 0.05 of the utterance). The vocabulary is a SentencePiece [ 14 ] BPE of 1,024 pieces trained only on the training transcripts after decontamination. The model has 31,564,935 parameters. Unless stated otherwise, decoding is greedy, in float32, TDT with at most 10 tokens per frame.
blocks.zh: 编码器有16个FastConformer层,宽度为256个,有4个注意头,向导扩展为4个,内核为9个并有深度相隔的分块,能将时间缩短为8倍. 编码器为两个输出提供素材,一个TDT解码器和一个CTC头. TDT解码器具有一层的预测网络和联合网络,两者都为宽度640,并预测出每个令牌的长度为0到4帧;TDT损失使用: = 0.02\sigma=0.02和 = 0.1\omega=0.1 [9]. 在第八层编码器后,对四氯化碳头进行0.3重量训练,并采用[11]重量0.3的中间减量。 输入是16000 Hz单声道为80个log-mel特性,有25ms窗口和10ms出行,并有SpecAugment [15](宽至27分的两个频率口罩和可达0.05分的10个时间口罩). 词汇是"PriedPiece [14] BPE",有1,024个片段在去污后仅被训练在训练记录上. 该模型有31,564,935个参数. 除非另有说明,解码是贪婪的,以活字32,TDT为单位,每帧最多有10个令牌.

blocks.en: The model writes Turkish with capital letters, the full stop, comma and question mark, the apostrophe and the hyphen inside words. Other punctuation in the training text was mapped to these marks, circumflex letters are written without the circumflex, and numbers are written as words ( iki bin yirmi ikide , not 2022’de ). A training text with a number form these rules cannot read, such as a dot decimal or a Roman ordinal, was dropped; Section 3 describes how ambiguous readings were resolved. It is a full-utterance model, so long recordings must be cut into utterances first.
blocks.zh: 该模型用大写字母写出土耳其语,全站,逗号与问号,apostrope和连字符内词. 训练文本中的其他标语被映射到这些印记上, 环法字母没有环法字母写出, 带有数字格式的训练文本无法读取这些规则,例如点小数或罗马正文被删除; 第3节描述了模糊读取是如何解决的. 这是一个完全切口的模型,所以长长的录音必须先被切成语音.

blocks.en: 3 Data
blocks.zh: 3 数据

blocks.en: Table 1 lists the training pool; every source’s licence allows commercial use. The human-transcribed sources are Common Voice Scripted Speech 27.0 in Turkish [ 24 ] , from which every clip whose sentence or speaker is in its development or test split was removed, and Common Voice Spontaneous Speech 5.0 in Turkish; antalia-voice-corpus [ 27 ] , one professional voice actor; and the train split of the Turkish Speech Corpus (TSC) of ISSAI [ 26 ] . ISSAI publishes the corpus under CC BY 4.0; the Hugging Face copy is tagged MIT, and CC BY 4.0 is the licence followed here. The rest of the pool is YouTube audio collected by YODAS [ 28 ] and YODAS v3 [ 29 ] , whose authors say they took only videos published under a Creative Commons licence and release the audio under CC BY 3.0; on YouTube the one Creative Commons licence an uploader can choose for a video is the Creative Commons Attribution licence (CC BY) [ 30 ] . Its three parts are the Turkish yodas0.10 subset of ESPnet’s OWSM v4 data [ 5 ] , the yodas0.00 recordings not in it, and Turkish YODAS v3 audio cut along the spans of Alania Turkish Speech Style Captions [ 31 ] (CC BY 4.0) and merged into units of at most 30 s; only the span boundaries of the Alania dataset were used, and its transcript column was never read. We call these the YODAS recordings.
blocks.zh: 表1列出培训人才库;每个来源的许可证允许商业使用。 人语源有:土耳其语的"共同语音脚本"(Common Voice Scripted Speech 27.0)[24],从中删除了每个其句子或扬声器正在开发或测试分拆的片段,土耳其语的"共同语音自发分解"(Common Voice Sponsideers 5.0;antalia-voice-corpus [27],一个专业语音演员;以及土耳其ISSAI的"语音公司"(TSC)的列车分拆[26]. ISSAI在CC BY 4.0下公布该诉讼案;Hugging Face副本被贴上麻省理工学院的标签,CC BY 4.0是在此之后的许可. 其余的由YODAS[28]和YODAS v3 [29]所收集的YouTube音频,其作者称他们只取了根据创用CC许可发布的视频,并以CC BY 3.0发布该音频;在YouTube上,上传者可以选择一个视频的创用CC许可(CC BY)[30]. 它的三个部分是ESPnet的OWSM v4数据的土耳其yodas0.10子集[5],其中未收录的yodas0.00录音,以及沿着阿拉尼亚土耳其语音风格标题[31](CC BY 4.0)的跨度被土耳其YODS v3音频剪接并合并为最多为30s的单位;只使用了阿拉尼亚数据集的跨度边界,其笔录栏从未被读取. 我们称之为YODS录音。

blocks.en: Table 1: The training pool. Hours count each recording once; speed-perturbed copies and repeats of the mix are not counted. For the YODAS recordings the hours are split by the origin of the training text, the uploader’s subtitle (subtitle) or a checked machine transcript (checked).
blocks.zh: 表1:培训池。 小时数每录一回;速度受干扰的拷贝和重复的混音不计. 对于YODAS录音,时间按培训文本的来源、上传者的字幕(子标题)或检查的机器记录稿(检查)来划分。

blocks.en: Automatic captions are never training text. Whisper large-v3-turbo [ 4 ] (MIT) transcribed every unit. Where an utterance has an uploader subtitle that agrees with that transcript within a WER of 0.2, the subtitle is the training text. Otherwise, with no subtitle or one that disagrees, the training text is the transcript, kept only where Omnilingual ASR CTC 7B v2 [ 6 ] (Apache-2.0), a CTC model from another maker, reads the same audio within a character error rate (CER) of 0.10; this check removed 1,134.62 hours. A number form with more than one spoken reading takes the reading that Omnilingual ASR scores highest on the audio if it beats the next by 2.0 nats; otherwise the unit keeps its rule-based reading or is dropped.
blocks.zh: 自动字幕从来不是训练文本 。 微声大V3涡轮 [4] (MIT)转录了每个单元. 如果一个语音有一个上传子字幕,在0.2的WER中与该文本一致,则该字幕是培训文本。 否则,如果没有字幕或有不同意见,培训文本就是笔录,只保存在来自另一个制作者的CTC模型Omnilantic ASR CTC 7B v2 [6] (Apache-2.0)在0.10字符出错率(CER)内读取相同的音频;这次检查取消了1,134.62小时. 一个有多个口语读取的数表,读取"Omnilanguage ASR"在音频上得分最高,如果它以2.0 nats击倒了下个;否则,单位会保持其以规则为主的读取或被放出.

blocks.en: Both models and the threshold were chosen on the ISSAI TSC development split (3,428 clips, 4.26 h), which is never trained on, under rules fixed before any score was computed. Whisper large-v3 did not transcribe it significantly better than large-v3-turbo (WER 0.1573 against 0.1630, difference − 0.0057 -0.0057 [ − 0.0170 -0.0170 , + 0.0014 +0.0014 ]), so the faster turbo was kept. Among the checking models, Omnilingual ASR CTC 7B v2 had the lowest CER, 0.0514, against 0.0599 for its 3B version and 0.0624 for Qwen3-ASR-1.7B [ 7 ] (Apache-2.0). The threshold is the loosest agreement at which the kept transcripts met fixed targets for their WER against the references and for the share of clips kept. At a CER of 0.10, 2,541 of 3,428 clips were kept, and their turbo transcripts have a WER of 0.1249, against 0.1630 for all clips. The ISSAI references are lowercase and unpunctuated and split some words, which raises every model’s absolute error rate here; all models are scored against the same references. The makers of Whisper, Omnilingual ASR and Qwen3-ASR do not fully disclose their training data. No output of these models other than the transcripts and readings above is training text.
blocks.zh: 根据计算出任何分数之前确定的规则,在ISSAI TSC开发分数(3,428个分数,4.26个分数)上选择了模型和分数。 微声大V3没有比大V3-涡轮(WER 0.1573对0.1630,相差-0.0057-0.0057[−0.0170-0.0170,+0.0014+0.0014])强得多地转录出它,因此保持了更快的涡轮. 在检查模型中,Omnilantic ASR CTC 7B v2的CER最低,为0.0514,而3B版本为0.0599,Qune3-ASR-1.7B版本为0.0624 (Apache-2.0)。 阈值是所保存的文字记录与参考文献相比达到固定目标的最宽松的协议,以及所保存剪辑的份额。 在0.10的CER中,保留了3,428个剪辑中的2,541个,其涡轮机记录片的WER为0.1249,而所有剪辑的WER为0.1630. ISSAI的引用是小写和不标出并分出一些单词,这提高了这里每个模型的绝对出错率;所有模型都根据同样的引用来打分. 华声,Omnilanguage ASR和Qune3-ASR的制作者并没有完全披露他们的训练数据. 除了上面的记录和阅读之外,这些模型的任何产出都不是培训文本。

blocks.en: One exclusion set holds the normalised references of every development and test set used here. It was matched against every training transcript and tokenizer line, by exact match and by shared word n n -grams, and audio fingerprints matched the training audio against the evaluation audio. The matches removed 432 training utterances, 206 of them ISSAI TSC clips matched by their audio; near-duplicate recordings across the three YODAS parts were removed as well. FLEURS (any split), the Common Voice development and test splits, Real-TurnTurk and the 2,511 MediaSpeech clips reported here were never trained on.
blocks.zh: 一套排除法保留了这里使用的每套开发和测试法的常态参考. 它与每条训练记录和标语标线、精确匹配和共享n克/克,音频指纹与训练音频相匹配,与评价音频相匹配。 配对删除了432个培训语句,其中206个是ISSA TSC剪辑,配有音频;还删除了YODS三个部分的近复制录音。 FLEURS(任何拆分), 共同之声开发与测试拆分, Real-TurnTurk和本文所报道的2,511个MediaSpeech片段从未接受过训练.

blocks.en: The training mix samples corpora by a temperature of 0.5 with at most 4 repeats of a source per pass, so the human-transcribed sources make up 25.7 percent of the hours of a pass. The human sources are speed-perturbed [ 21 ] . Noise from the MUSAN noise subset [ 23 ] (only files that MUSAN’s licence files mark as public domain or CC BY) was mixed into training audio at random, reverberation was added at random with the simulated room responses of the OpenSLR room impulse response database [ 22 ] (Apache-2.0), and noise cuts with an empty transcript make up 0.8 percent of the hours of a pass as examples of non-speech. Random gain, chosen by a pilot (Section 4 ), multiplies half of the training cuts by a level drawn uniformly between − 40 -40 and + 6 +6 dB, after noise and room responses, so speech, noise and reverberation scale together. The cooldown mix (Section 4 ) raises the human share to 40 percent and draws its YODAS units only from those whose deciding agreement is at most 0.05.
blocks.zh: 训练将蝎子样本以0.5的温度混合,每道通行证最多重复了4个来源,因此被人类描述的来源占通行证时间的25.7%. 人源被速度干扰 [21]. 来自MUSAN噪声子集[23](只有MUSAN的许可文件标为公有领域或CC BY的文件)的噪声被随机地混入了训练音频中,同OpenSLR房间冲动响应数据库的模拟室反应相随机地加入了反响(Apache-2.0),用空记录片的噪声剪接占了过关时间的0.8%作为非声波的例子. 随机增益,由飞行员(第4节)选择,将训练削减的一半乘以−40-40和+6+6分贝之间统一划出的水平,在噪音和房间反应后,因此语音,噪音和反响尺度相加. 冷却混合(第4节)将人的份额提高到40%,并且只从决定同意最多为0.05的人那里提取其YODS单位。

blocks.en: 4 Training and selection
blocks.zh: 4 培训和甄选

blocks.en: AdamW [ 17 ] with β = ( 0.9 , 0.98 ) \beta=(0.9,0.98) and weight decay 0.001, and the Noam schedule [ 16 ] with 8,000 warm-up steps, a peak learning rate of 0.0026 and a floor of 10 − 6 10^{-6} . Training starts with a short phase on shorter clips without noise or room responses, which earlier from-scratch runs of this project needed to leave the stage in which the model outputs only blanks. The released weights are an exponential moving average of the training weights.
blocks.zh: AdamW [17] 有β = (0.9,0.98)\βa= (0.9,0.98)和重量衰减0.001,和Noam表 [16] 有8,000个取暖步骤,峰值学习率为0.0026,下限为10-6 10^{-6}. 培训始于短片短片段的短片段,没有噪音或房间反应,从该项目的切入阶段开始,模型只输出空白。 所释放出重量是训练重量的指数移动平均值.

blocks.en: Before the full run, eleven pilot runs on the full data pool, each a trunk of the full schedule plus a short cooldown, were read at step 14,500 by rules fixed before any of them started. Eight formed a 2 3 2^{3} factorial over consistency-regularised CTC [ 12 ] against intermediate CTC, a CTC-side weight of 0.1 against 0.3, and BPE-dropout [ 13 ] of 0.1 against none; two more seeds of the baseline cell measured seed noise; an eleventh run added random gain to the baseline cell. The metric was the WER pooled over the words of both development sets. The three baseline seeds scored 0.1608, 0.1583 and 0.1601, so the noise term was set by its floor of 1 percent of their mean (0.0016). A change was adopted only if it passed a Holm correction [ 19 ] over the three main effects at one-sided 0.05, lowered the metric by at least 2 percent, and its interval on FLEURS alone did not lie wholly above zero. Gain was judged on the same metric at the original level, which it had to keep within 1 percent, and on audio attenuated by 20 and 30 dB, which it had to lower by at least 5 percent and by at least 1.645 standard errors. As Table 2 shows, none of the three recipe changes helped, and gain was adopted. The full run continued the gain pilot’s trunk with the baseline recipe and gain.
blocks.zh: 在全程运行前,11名飞行员运行在全程数据库上,每台全程的一干线加上一短冷却,在任何一台机组开始前按固定规则在步骤14500上读取. 8个组成了2 3 2 + 3 + 5 + 一致性规范化的CTC [12] 对中间的CTC, 四氯化碳侧重为0.1对0.3, BPE-抛出 [13] 对0.1; 基线细胞再有2个种子测出种子噪声; 第11次运行增加了基线细胞的随机增益. 衡量标准是WER集成在两套开发的词上。 三种基准种子得分为0.1608,0.1583和0.1601,因此噪声词被其下限定为其平均值(0.0016)的1%. 只有当Holm修正[19]在单侧0.05的三个主要效果时,通过修改,将衡量标准至少降低2%,而单是FLEURS的间隔时间并不完全高于零时,才通过修改。 增益的判断依据是原始水平的相同度量,它必须保持在1%以内,音频减低了20分贝和30分贝,它必须至少降低5%,至少降低1.645个标准错误。 如表2所显示的,这三项改变都无济于事,收益被采纳。 整个运行延续了增益飞行员的干线,并提供了基准配方和收益。

blocks.en: Table 2: Design pilots at step 14,500 on the development sets (Common Voice 27.0 dev and FLEURS dev, WER pooled over both). The effect is the mean of the runs with the choice minus the mean of the runs without it, four runs against four for the factorial rows and one run against the three baseline seeds for gain; positive is worse. The gain effect at the attenuated levels has z = − 4.19 z=-4.19 against the seed noise and bootstrap error.

blocks.en: The trunk ran to step 119,500; a rule fixed in advance would have extended it had the in-training validation WER on Common Voice dev (cased and punctuated text, moving-average weights) fallen by more than 2 percent relative over the last 10,000 steps, and it had not (0.1839 to 0.1845). Two cooldowns of 16,000 steps each then ran from the same checkpoint to step 135,500, lowering the learning rate η \eta from its value at step 119,500, η 0 \eta_{0} , to 10 − 6 10^{-6} as η k = 10 − 6 + ( η 0 − 10 − 6 ) ​ ( 1 − k / K ) \eta_{k}=10^{-6}+(\eta_{0}-10^{-6})\,(1-\sqrt{k/K}) after k k of the K = 16,000 K=16{,}000 steps [ 18 ] , one on the main mix and one on the cooldown mix. The candidates were each cooldown’s last checkpoint and the average of its last three saved checkpoints. The rule, fixed before any was scored, took the lowest mean WER over the two development sets, sent means equal to three decimals to the candidate with fewer checkpoints, and between two such to the main mix. All four means were 0.095, so the released model is the main-mix cooldown’s last checkpoint (0.0830 on Common Voice dev, 0.1071 on FLEURS dev). The two mixes do not differ significantly (cooldown-mix average minus main-mix average − 0.0009 -0.0009 [ − 0.0022 -0.0022 , + 0.0005 +0.0005 ] on Common Voice dev and + 0.0007 +0.0007 [ − 0.0033 -0.0033 , + 0.0048 +0.0048 ] on FLEURS dev). This training line, from the gain pilot’s first step through the main-mix cooldown, ran on A100 80 GB GPUs for 52.3 GPU session hours, which count setup, validation passes and checkpoint saves as well as training steps.

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5. 评价

blocks.en: Every recipe, checkpoint and export choice above was made on Common Voice 27.0 Turkish dev (11,864 utterances, 12.35 h, 163 speakers) and FLEURS Turkish dev [ 25 ] (338 utterances, 1.12 h); the labelling choices were made on ISSAI TSC dev. The release gate was fixed before any training. The model ships only if it beats Whisper base on FLEURS Turkish test and on Common Voice 27.0 Turkish test, each by a paired interval of the WER difference that lies wholly below zero. The test sets were scored once, for one model, in a first attempt that passed. Normalised WER passes reference and hypothesis through our Turkish normaliser, which applies Unicode NFC, removes bracketed spans, writes digits as separate words with a verbaliser adapted from the TurkASR-Bench normaliser [ 37 ] , lowercases in the Turkish way (I to ı, İ to i), removes in-word apostrophes and all other punctuation, folds circumflexes and drops filler words such as ı , ee , hmm and aa . Whisper base, small and large-v3 [ 3 ] (MIT) were scored by us with the same normaliser, greedy and, for base and small, with the Whisper package’s decoding settings as transformers implements them (beam 5 with temperature fallback); each comparison uses the better of the two on that set. These scores were computed before any training, those on MediaSpeech before the gate.
blocks.zh: 上述每一处食谱、检查站和出口选择都是用土耳其语(11,864个口音,12.35个口音,163个口音)和FLEURS土耳其语(25个口音,338个口音,1.12个口音)制作的;标签选择是在土耳其语(ISSAI TSC口音)上制作的。 在任何训练之前,释放门已经固定。 模型舰只在FLEURS土耳其测试和Creative Voice 27.0土耳其测试上击败Whisper基座,每艘由完全位于零以下的WER差数一对相隔. 试播集的得分是一次, 对于一个模型, 第一次尝试通过。 普通的WER通过使用Unicode NFC的土耳其常态器传递参考和假说,去掉括号的横幅,用从TurkASR-Bench正态器改编的单词将数字写作单独的单词 [37],用土耳其语写出小写(I至 ı, İ至i),去掉单词缩写和所有其他平分,折叠环形和倒放填词,如 ı, ee, hmm和 aa等. Whisper base, 小型和大V3 [3] (麻省理工学院) 被我们用同样的常态来打分,贪得无厌,对于基础和小的,在变压器执行时,Whisper 包的解码设置(第5行与回温相接;每作比较都使用该套中两个的更好. 这些分数是在任何训练前计算的,在大门前的MediaSpeech上。

The model was trained once, with one seed; the intervals come from resampling the test sets, not from repeated training. On the development sets the TDT decoder has the lower WER (Common Voice dev 0.0830 [0.0750, 0.0921] against 0.1075 [0.0983, 0.1175] for the CTC head; FLEURS dev 0.1071 against 0.1306); no paired test was run.

blocks.en: On Real-TurnTurk [ 32 ] , conversational speech of 6 speakers, the WER is 0.3807, about four times that of read speech, and lower than Whisper base and small. MediaSpeech [ 33 ] is media speech. Its makers say part of its utterances come from Mozilla Common Voice, so every clip linked by text or audio to Common Voice or to our training audio was removed first; 2 of 2,513 clips matched our training audio, and no clip matched a Common Voice 27.0 sentence or Common Voice dev or test audio. Its references join compound numbers into one word, so part of its WER comes from the reference style; the CER with spaces removed is 0.0420. Whisper’s training data is not fully disclosed, so this set may not be unseen for Whisper.
blocks.zh: 在Real-TurnTurk [32]上,6个演讲者的谈话演说,WER是0.3807,大约是阅读演说的4倍,也低于Whisper基础和小. MediaSpeech [33] 是媒体言论. 其制作人称其部分言论出自"莫齐拉共同之声"(Mozilla Community Voice),因此每个以文字或音频链接到"共同之声"(Common Voice)或"我们训练之声"(我们训练之声)的片段被先去取出;2,513个片段中有2个与我们的训练之声相匹配,没有片段与"共同之声"(Common Voice 27.0)句或"共同之声"(Common Voice dev)或测试之声相匹配. 它的引用将复合数字合并为一个单词,因此其WER的一部分出自参考样式;有去除空格的CER为0.0420. Whisper的训练数据没有完全披露,因此这个集可能不为Whisper所见.

blocks.en: The text as written is scored on the test sets against references whose punctuation is mapped to the model’s marks (Table 4 ). PC-WER counts marks and capitals as words; PuncER and CaseER are the parts of the error that come from marks and from capitals [ 34 ] (the count of reference words with a capital, which that paper’s equation does not define, is our reading); PER is the punctuation error rate of LibriSpeech-PC [ 35 ] , computed as NeMo implements it. Full stops are recalled far more often than commas (FLEURS test 0.839 against 0.359, Common Voice test 0.939 against 0.612). On Real-TurnTurk, where every reference ends in a mark, the model writes few marks (full-stop recall 0.171, comma recall 0.031) and often misplaces capitals (capital precision 0.365, recall 0.272).
blocks.zh: 标注在模型标记上的参考文献(表4)。 PC-WER计算出标记和首府为单词; PuncER和CaseER是出自标记和首府的误差部分 [34] (使用一个大写,该纸方程没有定义的参考词的倒数是我们读取的); PER是LibriSpeech-PC [35] 的平分误差率,由 NeMo 执行时计算出 。 整站比逗号更经常被召回(FLEURS测试0.839对0.359,普通语音测试0.939对0.612). 在"Real-TurnTurk"上,每个引用以一个标记结尾,模型会写出几分标记(全站回想0.171,逗号回想0.031)并经常错置首都(首都精度0.365,回想0.272).

blocks.en: Table 4: Punctuation and casing on the test sets (lower is better except capital F1). The WER without marks or casing removes only marks and capitals, with the reference numbers written as the model writes them, so it differs from the normalised WER of Table 3 . The last column describes the references, not the model.
blocks.zh: 表4:测试装置上的标注和外壳(低一些更好,资本F1除外). 无标记或外壳的WER只去除标记和首府,参考号如模型所写,因此不同于表3的常态WER. 最后一栏描述的是参考文献,而不是模型.

blocks.en: FLEURS, Common Voice and Real-TurnTurk test were also scored on stored copies of their audio, made once before the gate (Table 5 ); MediaSpeech has no such copies. The copies are the audio compressed with the Opus audio codec [ 36 ] at 6,000 and 12,000 bit/s in voice mode and decoded with libopus, telephone-band audio at 8,000 Hz with A-law coding, and the original audio attenuated by 20 and 30 dB. The 6,000 bit/s Opus copies cost the most and the telephone band the next most; 12,000 bit/s Opus and attenuation by 20 dB cost at most 0.0135, and at 30 dB FLEURS test loses 0.0205.
blocks.zh: FLEURS, 常见的语音和实时 Turk测试还得分于其录音的存储副本,在大门前做过一次(表5);MediaSpeech没有这种副本。 复制品是用Opus音频编码器压缩的音频[36],语音模式为6000和1.2万比特/秒,并用libopus解码,电话带音频为8000. Hz有A-law编码,而原声被20分和30分贝削弱. 6000个比特 Opus拷贝成本最高,电话波段成本再高;12,000比特/s Opus并减速20分贝成本最高为0.0135分;而30分贝FLEURS测试损失为0.0205分.

blocks.en: Table 5: WER change on degraded copies of the test audio, copy minus original, same model, paired interval.
blocks.zh: 表5:测试音频退化拷贝上的WER变化,副本减去正本,同型,成对间隔.

blocks.en: 6 Exports
blocks.zh: 6 出口

blocks.en: Each export was decoded on both development sets and counted only if its normalised WER stayed within 0.005 of the NeMo decoding it implements on each set, with no failed utterance; a reduced setting (the int8 and q8_0 files, and the MLX weights run at bfloat16) was also held to its full-precision counterpart by the same margin. Each runtime is compared with the NeMo decoding that follows its own rule at the per-frame token cap. Table 6 gives the files that ship.
blocks.zh: 每个导出在两个开发集上被解码,并且只有在它所执行的每集的NeMo解码在0.005以内时才算入;一个减码的设置(int8和q8_0文件,以及运行于bfloat16的MLX权重)也以同样的比值被扣入其完全精确的对应器. 每个运行时间都与NeMo解码比对,它遵循了自己在每帧符号封顶上的规则. 表6提供了该船的档案。

blocks.en: Table 6: Shipped exports against NeMo 3.0.0 on the development sets (CV: Common Voice 27.0), with transformers 5.20.1, sherpa-onnx 1.13.8, parakeet.cpp v0.6.1, and parakeet-mlx 0.5.3 on mlx 0.32.4. The sherpa-onnx rows are the int8 files the examples load; the float32 copies also ship.
blocks.zh: 表6:在开发套装(CV: Community Voice 27.0)上对NeMo 3.0.0进行出货,变压器为5.20.1,Sherpa-onnx 1.13.8,parakeet.cpp v0.6.1,mlx0.32.0.5. shelpa-onnx行是Int8文件的示例负载;活浮32副本也相去相去.

blocks.en: The transformers TDT and CTC folders give NeMo’s token ids on every development utterance, and the pipeline interface gave the same text as generate on 10 of 10 utterances of each set and head. One GGUF file serves both heads in parakeet.cpp; its token ids differ from NeMo’s on some utterances, but WER stays within 0.0018 of NeMo.
blocks.zh: 变压器 TDT 和 CTC 文件夹为 NeMo 的每个开发语句提供了代号, 管道接口提供的文字与每集和头的10个发音相同。 一个GGUF文件在parakeet.cpp中为两个头都服务;其符号代号在某些言论上与NeMo不同,但WER留在NeMo的0.0018以内.

blocks.en: The sherpa-onnx feature front end differs from NeMo’s in six options. On an earlier model of the same architecture, with its own data and tokenizer, an ablation that moved each option alone found only one that closed the gap, the small constant added before the logarithm, which weighs most on low-energy frames; the others moved WER slightly. On FLEURS dev the sherpa-onnx TDT path was + 0.0108 +0.0108 [ + 0.0055 +0.0055 , + 0.0163 +0.0163 ] against NeMo’s features and − 0.0015 -0.0015 [ − 0.0052 -0.0052 , + 0.0021 +0.0021 ] with only NeMo’s constant, the change merged upstream on 21 October 2026 and released in sherpa-onnx v2.0.0 on 23 October 2026 [ 41 ] ; the files were measured with 1.13.8. Multiplying the input by 8 before decoding is a workaround that holds at normal recording levels, and the files ship with it. For the released model the float32 files also pass at gain 1, but the int8 files fail there ( + 0.0071 +0.0071 for TDT and + 0.0068 +0.0068 for CTC with the pad on FLEURS dev) and pass at gain 8. The gain does not help on quiet audio. At − 30 -30 dB the shipped TDT and CTC files lose 0.0369 and 0.0427 on FLEURS test, against 0.0205 for NeMo.
blocks.zh: Sherpa-onnx的前端与NeMo不同, 在同一架构的更早的模型上,用自己的数据和活化器,一个单独移动每个选项的活化物只发现一个能关闭缺口的,小常数在对数前添加,在低能框架上重量最大;而其他的则略微移动了WER. FLEURS dev sherpa-onx TDT路径为+0.0108+0.0108 [+0.0055+0.0055,+0.0163+0.0163]与NeMo的特征相对应,并有−0.0015-0.0015 [-0.0052-0.0052,+0.0052+0.0021],只有NeMo的常数,变化于2026年10月21日上游合并后于2026年10月23日以Sherpa-onx v 2.0.0发布;文件以1.13.8. 在解码前将输入数乘以8,是一种在正常录制水平上坚守的活计,文件随同传送. 对于已发布的模型,浮点32文件也以增益1通过,但其中的倒数8文件失效(TDT为+0.0071+0.0071,CTC为+0.0068+0.0068,并用FLEURS dev上的垫子)并用增益8通过. 好处对静音没有帮助. 在-30-30分贝时,所发运的TDT和CTC文件在FLEURS测试中损失了0.0369和0.0427,而NeMo为0.0205。

blocks.en: The sherpa-onnx NeMo CTC runtime sets the output length to the number of feature frames divided by the time reduction, rounded down, rather than to the encoder’s own length, so the last encoder frame is dropped whenever the frame count is not a multiple of 8. In this cased model that frame often carries the final mark. Normalised WER does not see the loss. Of 11,864 Common Voice dev hypotheses, 1,788 end in a mark with the stock runtime and 11,644 with NeMo’s own CTC decoding; appending zeros to the input up to the next multiple of 8 frames, which our example code does, gives 11,637. The TDT files are not affected.
blocks.zh: sherpa-onnx NeMo CTC运行时间将输出长度设定为除以时间缩短的特性帧数,四舍五入,而不是编码器本身的长度,因此当帧数不是8倍数时,最后一个编码器帧被放弃. 在这种情况下,框架往往带有最终标记。 正常的WER没有看到损失。 11 864人中常见 Voice dev 假说,1,788个以股票运行时间为标记结束,11,644个以NeMo自己的CTC解码结束;在输入上附加0到下个8个帧的倍数,这是我们的例子代码做的,给出了11,637个. TDT文件不受影响.

blocks.en: parakeet-mlx computes its input features differently from NeMo, so the MLX folder ships float32 weights with a feature function that computes NeMo’s features with numpy and passes them to parakeet-mlx’s decoder, which runs the weights at bfloat16, its default; the package’s own front end is not a checked path. bfloat16 counted only if two independent full runs gave identical token ids on every development utterance, which they did. These numbers were measured on mlx’s CPU backend under Linux; the MLX files were not run on Apple silicon.
blocks.zh: Parakeet-mlx计算其输入特性与NeMo不同,因此MLX文件夹船浮动了32个重量,其特性功能用数字来计算NeMo的特性并传递给parakeet-mlx的解码器,它运行了bfloat16的重量,它的默认值;包自己的前端不是被检查的路径. bfloat16 只有在两个独立的全程在每次开发言论上给出相同的代号时才算数,他们这样做了. 这些数字被测量在Linux下的mlx的CPU后端;MLX文件没有运行在Apple硅上.

blocks.en: The int8 sherpa-onnx TDT file at gain 8 scores 0.0921 on FLEURS test and 0.0932 on Common Voice test, 0.0000 and + 0.0016 +0.0016 from NeMo’s TDT decoding. The int8 CTC file with the pad scores 0.1128 and 0.1200, + 0.0207 +0.0207 and + 0.0284 +0.0284 from NeMo’s TDT decoding. That comparison includes the difference between the heads. In NeMo the CTC head’s WER is 0.0245 higher than TDT’s on Common Voice dev, and the CTC file is within 0.0032 of NeMo’s own CTC decoding there.
blocks.zh: 在FLEURS测试中得分为0.0921分,在普通语音测试中得分为0.0932分,从NeMo的TDT解码中得分为0.000和+0.0016+0.0016分. 平板电脑的int8 CTC文件得分为:0.128分和0.120分,+0.0207分和+0.0207分和+0.0284分,来自NeMo的TDT解码. 这种比较包括了头部的区别. 在NeMo中,CTC头目的WER比普通Voicedev上的TDT高0.0245,CTC的文件在NeMo自己的CTC解码的0.

blocks.en: The shipped sherpa-onnx files were timed on 60 development utterances in three length buckets (2 to 5, 5 to 15 and 15 to 30 s), each row in a fresh process with one untimed and five timed passes. On an Apple M1 at one thread (sherpa-onnx 1.13.8, Python) the median real-time factor in the 15 to 30 s bucket is 0.0101 for the int8 TDT files and 0.0155 for the float32 ones, and the median int8 TDT decode time there is 0.170 s; in headless Chrome 155 on the same machine the demo’s int8 TDT files run at 0.0311. On a 2-vCPU x86-64 Linux cloud server (Intel Xeon at 2.20 GHz, a shared virtual machine) the int8 TDT files run at a median real-time factor of 0.0364 at one thread, and every two-thread row there had a higher real-time factor than the same file at one thread. Cold load, decode times and peak memory for every file are in the model card.
blocks.zh: 所发运的Sherpa-onnx文件在60个开发语句上被分出3个长度桶(2至5个,5至15个和15至30 s)的时间,每行在新过程中有1个未发时间和5个发时间的通行证. 在一线的Apple M1上(sherpa-onx 1.13.8,Python),15至30 s桶的中位实时因子为:int8 TDT文件为0.0101,flobt32文件为0.0155;中位nt8 TDT解码时间为0.170 s;同台机上无头的Chrome 155上,demo's int8 TDT文件运行于0.0311. 在2-vCPU x86-64 Linux云服务器上(Intel Xeon at 2.20 GHz,一款共享虚拟机),一线上以0.0364的中位实时系数运行的int8 TDT文件,一线上每行两行的实时系数都高于一线上同一文件. 每个文件的冷负载,解码时间和峰值内存都在模型卡中.

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: The model reads Turkish only; other languages and Turkish mixed with them were not measured. It is not a streaming model and decodes one utterance at a time, so long recordings need voice activity detection first, with a few hundred milliseconds of audio kept around each segment; a segment cut tight to the speech can come out without capitals or punctuation. It does not separate speakers, and its word timestamps were not checked. Numbers come out as words, so an application that needs digits must convert them. Conversational speech is much harder for it than read speech, and Real-TurnTurk has only 6 speakers. Accuracy by speaker gender, age or regional accent was not measured. Commas are often missed. Most of the training text of the YODAS recordings (4,326.59 of 4,696.21 hours) was written by one recogniser and checked by another, where no uploader subtitle agreed with the transcript; errors on which the two agreed remain in the training text. The model was trained with one seed, so seed variance is not measured. The sherpa-onnx files need the input gain and, for CTC, the pad, and they lose more than NeMo on quiet audio; the MLX path was not measured on Apple silicon; transformers decodes TDT without NeMo’s per-frame token cap, which changed no development utterance. MediaSpeech’s interval may be too narrow, and its references join compound numbers.
blocks.zh: 该模型只读取土耳其语;其他语言和与它们混合的土耳其语没有被测量. 它不是一个流体模型,一次解码一个语句,所以长的录音首先需要语音活动探测,每个片段周围留有几百毫秒的音频;切入到讲话的片段可以不带首都或发音而出. 它没有分开发言,也没有检查它的字号时间戳。 数字作为单词出来,所以需要数字的应用程序必须转换. 对话演说对于它来说比阅读演说更难,而Real-TurnTurk只有6个演说者. 按性别、年龄或区域口音分列的准确性没有加以衡量。 逗号经常被错过. YODAS录音的大部分培训文本(4,696.21小时中的4,326.59个)由一名识别员编写,另一名识别员检查,没有上传员的字幕与记录稿一致;培训文本中仍然有双方商定的错误。 该模型是用一粒种子来训练的,因此种子差异没有被测量. shelpa-onnx文件需要输入增益,对于CTC来说,垫子,它们在静音上损失比NeMo多;MLX路径没有在苹果硅上被测量;变压器解码为TDT,没有NeMo的每帧符号封顶,没有改变开发表达. MediaSpeech的间隔可能太窄了,其引用与复数结合.

blocks.en: 8 Release
blocks.zh: 8 发布

blocks.en: The Hugging Face repository holds, under Apache-2.0, the NeMo file, transformers folders for TDT and CTC, sherpa-onnx TDT and CTC files in float32 and int8, GGUF files in f32 and q8_0, the MLX folder with float32 weights and its feature function, the Apache-2.0 licence text, one checksum file and an attribution file that credits every dataset with its licence and citation. The NeMo file is 126,955,520 bytes, the three int8 sherpa-onnx TDT files together 42,980,244 bytes and the q8_0 GGUF file 58,147,232 bytes. The release is at these addresses. Weights, card and attribution https://huggingface.co/ufakai/ufakzeka-kulak Code https://github.com/ufakai/ufakzeka-kulak Demo https://kulak.ufakzeka.com
blocks.zh: Hugging Face寄存器在Apache-2.0下有:NeMo文件,TDT和CTC的变压器文件夹,Sherpa-onnx TDT和CTC文件以活浮32和int8为单位,GGUF文件以f32和q8_0为单位,有活浮32重量及其特征功能的MLX文件夹,Apache-2.0许可文本,一个检查和归属文件以许可证和引用方式贷记每个数据集. NeMo文件为126,955,520字节,三个int8 serpa-onnx TDT文件共为42,980,244字节和q8_0 GGUF文件为58,147,232字节. 发布是在这些地址。 重量、卡片和归属 代码 https://github.com/ufakai/ufakzeka-kulak 页面存档备份,存于互联网档案馆. 演示 https://kulak.ufakzeka.com (中文(简体) ).
